text: Mema-sella ɓiɗɗo Maryama on salataa o haɗitaaki nde o laatotoo jeyaaɗo Alla, wanaa Malaa'ikaaɓe ɓe Ɓaɗtinani mo ɓen. Honno jogitorton Iisaa rewe- teeɗo ?! Ko honno sirkooɓe ɓen kadi jogitorta Malaa'ikaaɓe ɓen reweteeɗi ?! Kala non nefinanii- ɗo rewugol Alla ngol, o townitanii ɗum, pellet, Alla Mooɓitoyay ɓe denndaangal faade ka Makko Ñalnde Darngal, O Yoɓita kala e ko hanndi kon.
